source.title: Control of mitochondrial integrity influences oocyte quality during reproductive aging.
source.authorString: Khan SA, Reed L, Schoolcraft WB, Yuan Y, Krisher RL.

verdict.classification: Preclinical developmental-function comparator under oxidative challenge
verdict.summary: Retain subsequent blastocyst/hatching/ICM-percentage benefits from concurrent MQ exposure during high-oxygen mouse IVM, while preserving maturation/fertilization and low-oxygen nulls. PRKN protein responses support a different target hypothesis, not BubR1 restoration.

compound.supplier: Cayman Chemicals, Ann Arbor, MI, USA
compound.source_structure_description: Synthetic ubiquinone moiety linked to lipophilic triphenylphosphonium cation
compound.formulation_limit: Source does not establish mesylate/bromide identity, a current retail MitoQ preparation or ordinary CoQ10 equivalence. No forced catalog join.

exposure.route: Culture-medium addition during mouse cumulus-oocyte-complex IVM
exposure.altitude_note: Authors describe normal conditions as equivalent to5% O2/6% CO2 at sea level.
exposure.timing: MQ and oxygen challenge concurrent during IVM; not delayed repair of separately established damage.
exposure.post_IVM: MII selected by polar body; IVF with1×10^6 BDF1 sperm/mL; two-pronuclear zygotes selected after6h and transferred to sequential embryo culture. No continued MQ exposure in embryo culture established.

models.mouse: Outbred CF1 females,2 months young and13.5 months aged; separate baseline IVO comparisons and IVM treatment experiments.
models.human: Discarded immature GV oocytes from IVF patients, matured24h and selected as MII; untreated young<32 versus AMA>38 comparison, not an MQ clinical or human-cell intervention.

functional_outcomes.tested_population: Young mouse oocytes matured under high O2
functional_outcomes.comparison: MQ versus no MQ within high O2
MQ versus no MQ within high O2

functional_outcomes.endpoint: ICM cells as percentage of total blastocyst cells
functional_outcomes.comparison: MQ versus no MQ within high O2
functional_outcomes.limit: Not absolute ICM count, all-oocyte success or implantation; selected blastocysts only.

functional_outcomes.result: No significant differences among any treatment groups.
functional_outcomes.limit: No equivalence or broad safety claim.

functional_scope_limits: No current-study embryo transfer, pregnancy, live pups or offspring health outcome.
No current-study chromosome counting, karyotype, spindle scoring or segregation assay.
Spindle/chromosome rescue statements in Discussion cite earlier20/50nM studies, not this25nM experiment.
Precise denominator for each developmental percentage and total Figure6 embryo counts not tabulated; two-pronuclear selection prevents assuming all retrieved oocytes as denominator.
No exact numerical effect/CI reconstructed from bars.

protein_and_mitochondrial_results.aged_mouse_positive: MQ increases total PRKN and phospho-PRKN(S65); p-PRKN not significantly different from young. Increased mitochondria/lysosome Pearson colocalization.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.aged_mouse_nulls: MQ does not significantly restore HSPD1/LONP1; PINK1 not significantly altered. Baseline young-versus-aged colocalization is nonsignificant.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.high_oxygen_positive: MQ increases p-PRKN(S65), reduces the elevated mtDNA-copy estimate and increases colocalization.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.high_oxygen_nulls: Total PRKN, HSPD1, LONP1 and PINK1 have no significant treatment response; low-oxygen MQ p-PRKN/mtDNA/developmental outcomes nonpositive. Baseline high-oxygen colocalization is not reported significantly reduced.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.human_positive_association: Total and phospho-PRKN lower in AMA oocytes, each P≤.05.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.human_null_associations: HSPD1, LONP1, SQSTM1 and PINK1 not significantly different.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.assay: Jess antibody-reactive peak area normalized to total protein signal from the same capillary; fold change relative to controls.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.activity_limit: p-PRKN amount is not a direct enzymatic activity assay; no p-PRKN/total-PRKN ratio supplied.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.flux_limit: Equatorial dye colocalization is not measured degradation flux. Potential-dependent MitoTracker detects healthy mitochondria, a limitation acknowledged by authors; drug-related potential effects could alter labeling.
protein_and_mitochondrial_results.causality: Authors explicitly report no RNAi/knockout loss-of-function test. No PRKN-mediated necessity/rescue or BUB1B mediation established.

BUB1B_scope.basis: No such assay/result in fully read scientific main, all main figures or supplied supplement. Finite source-level absence, not global evidence of no possible effect.
BUB1B_scope.different_protein: PRKN is not BUBR1. mtDNA copy number is not nuclear chromosome-number fidelity.

biological_units.mouse_proteins: Pooled oocytes,3 for abundant HSPD1/LONP1 and generally15–20 for other targets in Methods; Results mentions10–15. Figure n values3–8 refer to assay biological replicates, not all independent animals.
biological_units.mouse_imaging: Methods report at least3 independent experiments with oocytes from8 young and15–20 aged mice per replicate; exact donor distribution for every functional/protein assay is not mapped.
biological_units.human_donors: Native TableS1 lists10 young and10 aged donors. Methods states13–15 MII oocytes per age category.
biological_units.human_assay_units: Most proteins measured in single oocytes; p-PRKN pools3 oocytes, n=4. Figure7 target-specific n varies; cannot add across assays or equate oocyte n with donor n.
biological_units.human_confounding: Most young donors have no female fertility issue; aged donors include diminished reserve and other conditions. No adjustment beyond age comparison or per-assay donor map.
biological_units.allocation: Randomization and blinding not reported in inspected main; donor-clustered models not described.
biological_units.statistics: Mean±SEM; t tests, one-/two-way ANOVA with Tukey; at least3 biological replicates. No individual-data replay, complete interaction estimates or global multiplicity guarantee.

source_discrepancies: Figure6 caption reverses development versus hatching panels A/B; use native A=development and B=hatching.
Figure5 caption says three groups but lists/shows four; no arm is omitted in this assessment.
Some HSPD1 labels are transposed as HSDP1; identity interpreted from paper context and antibody table, without claiming a second target.
Main abstract describes human MII samples without emphasizing that discarded GVs were matured in vitro; Methods supplies that qualification.
safety_and_exposure_limits: No organism dosing, pharmacokinetics or systematic developmental/systemic toxicity study. Low-O2 functional nulls are not proof of safety or equivalence. Culture concentration cannot establish a usable oral exposure.
study_independence: One published primary study with several mouse experiments and an observational human arm, not several independent replications. No new read credit for cited earlier studies; no transfer of ordinary CoQ10 outcomes.
funding: Internal Colorado Center for Reproductive Medicine research fund; authors declare no competing interests.
followup_questions: Identify exact Cayman catalog/salt, batch and stock/vehicle details without inferring a mesylate join.
Obtain experimental donor/animal-to-pool maps and Figure6 denominators for appropriate clustered estimates.
Test whether PRKN-dependent flux is necessary for developmental benefit rather than correlated protein/dye changes.
Resolve whether aged-oocyte treatment improves actual embryo/live-birth outcomes; current functional trial uses young high-oxygen oocytes.
access: Initial OUP endpoint403; official web tool redirected to public publisher CDN article-minimal page, which supplied full scientific HTML and signed public supplement/native-image links. Main PDF403 retained as invalid HTML; no main-PDF read credit. No bypass or author contact.
